intent_snapshot.goal: Legacy carrier source line (#377). In the Initiative Carrier Preference section of plugins/immune-brain/dist/draw-up.md, the carrier source line becomes a required output placed directly after the four-step resolution list instead of a trailing clause: once steps 1-3 select a carrier, the Planner shows one non-blocking line naming the selected carrier and its source as visible reply text before any question about decomposition, the Initiative or the carrier destination, and for a legacy:<path> source the same output shows the deprecated_config_source warning that names the replacement layer, key and file. Resolution order, the invalid-value rule, the no-silent-default rule and the GitHub confirmation rules are unchanged. User-visible: draw-up prints the source line and deprecation warning before its first Initiative question. The manual SCN-2 re-run that #377 asks for (at least twice) is model behaviour no deterministic descriptor can prove; it stays a post-merge manual check outside this acceptance.
